task.title: Open a family tree file
task.shortdesc: Bring a tree from another program, or a copy from a relative, into uFTi.

context.p: A family tree file ends in .ged or .gdz. also opens a .zip that holds one. Read first if the file is the only copy you have.

stepresult.p: The Windows window for opening a file appears.

step.cmd: Choose the file, then choose Open.

stepresult.p: A summary appears. It counts the people, families, events and sources in the file. It says if there are pictures. It also says that your changes are saved to this file.
The tree has a card on . The card is marked .

result.p: The cards sit side by side. Choose a card to make that tree the open one. Choose on a card to see which file it is.
result.note: The summary writes the name with hyphens, such as Brontë-family-of-Haworth. The card writes it with spaces. They are the same tree. If you open a second file with the same name, the card adds (2).
